query: Centralize user-facing errors for all TanStack Query v5 mutations. Individual mutations may still need optimistic rollback or inline form errors, and some must suppress global feedback via mutation metadata.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent subscribes to MutationCache and branches on internal event.action fields, or uses overridable default mutation options that fail to observe every mutation.
expected_behavior: Creates a MutationCache with its public global onError callback and installs it in the QueryClient
Uses mutation.meta for an explicit silent opt-out
Keeps local onError handlers for rollback or inline state while global notification remains centralized
anti_expectation: Does NOT depend on the MutationCache subscription event.action shape
Does NOT suppress the global callback merely because a mutation also defines a local onError
